Email from [[Mike Adamson|Michael Adamson]], tournament director of Event 4 of the [[2026 Retro League]] ([[Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)]]), to Retro League players, 11 October 2026: the welcome message, a ruling note asking players not to use a GEMP bug that lets a Patrol Craft deploy with a driver as a react, the week 1 pairings (34 tables, games due 18 October 2026) and the Retro League participant list with GEMP and forum names. The first page shows his short follow-up of the same evening correcting the week 1 deadline.

== Source ==
* Email "Re: 2026 Online Retro League - Event 4 Classic No V modified - Welcome and Week 1 Pairings" from Michael Adamson to Retro League players, 11 October 2026. Received by [[Bill Bisco]] as a player and printed from Gmail to PDF on 13 October 2026; provided by Bill.

== Changes ==
* Redacted copy: for privacy, every email address, the Gmail print header's page address and each participant's time zone and availability are blacked out, and the pages are rasterised. The message text, player names, pairings and GEMP and forum names are otherwise unchanged.

== Preservation ==
* Redacted PDF (version of 23 November 2026): Internet Archive backup pending.
